description.subtitle: 2. UI/UX & Core Contributions

title: IKK Workspace – Enterprise Workforce Management App

description.subtitle: 1. Project Overview & Role
description.details: Production-ready Enterprise Workforce Management application developed as a Flutter Developer at IntersoftKK Pvt. Ltd. (2026 – Present) to manage end-to-end organizational workflows.

description.subtitle: 2. Key Modules & Features
description.details: Implements Attendance & Location Tracking, Timesheets, Leave Management, Expense Reimbursements, and Performance Tracking, complete with document scanning and digital signatures.

description.subtitle: 3. Technology & Architecture
description.details: Built with Flutter using Clean Architecture, BLoC state management, and GetIt for dependency injection. Integrates REST APIs, Socket.IO, Firebase Cloud Messaging, SQLite offline caching, secure storage, and Firebase Crashlytics with separate dev and production configurations.

description.subtitle: 1. Platform Overview & Features
description.details: Social travel-sharing mobile platform featuring posts, photos, videos, 24-hour stories, highlights, likes, comments, and configurable public/private profiles.

description.subtitle: 2. Real-Time Messaging & Notifications
description.details: Implements real-time one-to-one messaging with emoji reactions, typing indicators, online presence, and push notifications using Socket.IO and Firebase.

description.subtitle: 3. Technology & Architecture
description.details: Built using Flutter (Clean Architecture, BLoC) for the frontend and Node.js, Express, and MongoDB for the backend, integrating Cloudinary media uploads, JWT authentication with token rotation, and email OTP verification.
